blocks.text: SPAWNING OF A NEW AGE— Some of the most fantastic events ever seen by man have been occurring. But even much greater will be happening soon! Some things will take place that seem beyond science fiction! — “People are being led into a fantasy world, but there is a rude awakening because the shock waves of reality will strike from every direction from the Almighty!” —“Our age is now seeing some of the most vital prophecies now more than ever!” Finishing up our church age. What an hour to be living in! It’s like watching the sun set as Christ will catch us up. As the Scripts said, great celestial signs will be given from the heaven! We just saw some pictures that were taken in the sky; and they were some of the most startling and beautiful colors that a person would be privileged to photograph. Some thought it might be ice crystals mixed up in the clouds, but these were totally different. They were similar to some of the Pictures shot here at Capstone! These were an array of rare colors seldom seen! Our Lord said, “great sights and signs shall there be from the heavens!” — You might call it supernatural splendor in the sky.

THE EYE OPENING AGE OF FULLNESS— Truly we are living in a mysterious period of wonders! On the one hand, God’s true manifestations, and on the other hand, the most evil and diabolical types of delusion are transpiring all around the earth! — “The end of the century is rushing towards us and with startling revelations and events!” I feel led to put this Scripture here at this moment. Amos 3:6-8, Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid? Shall there be evil in a city, and the Lord hath not done it? Surely the Lord, God will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets. The lion hath roared, who will not fear? The Lord God hath spoken, who can but prophesy? 4

CONTINUING— The Scripts have proven themselves in like manner and the Scriptures above. Some of my partners write by reading the newspaper, listening to radio and T.V., and the pictures of news on the front of Magazines, that they are using some of the same type of words that the spirit forecast decades ago! For one thing we told of a world crises in 1995. And the worst terrorist attacks took place in the history of the United States! — “‘And yet more crises are to transpire! Watch the future! — A flood of acute events are coming!” — One evening the Lord began to reveal different things in front of me, like lights, and then a little later on He revealed to me, and men were moving some real valuable and precious assets into different places! In one place, they had a large storage of different jewels, and valuable sparkling stones, things like silver and gold. The things of real value was being stored away! — “Because a little later in this century, we will have a new money system! — “Evidently moving towards a mostly cashless society leading to the mark! Commercial Babylon is and will become global soon. (Rey. Chap. 18) — Surely this is wakeup time! We know the world system will control the real wealth of the earth!

THE HOUR OF DANGEROUS AND PERILOUS TIMES— Truly, the Lord will give us great faith and joy! But also He is giving other events to warn the world and to keep His children alert. — The earth will have in the future, greater quakes than the one that struck in 1906 in California and the big one that hit Los Angeles! — “Besides different parts of the world, California will have some more major quakes and then the great giant catastrophe will appear at the appointed time! — “The pendulum swings in the celestial heavens! “‘As the Lord of hosts is shewing forth many signs, conjunctions, movements and strange phenomenon that scientists have never seen before!” — Note: I will give just a little information concerning a news clip that was sent to me out of a Magazine. Just awhile back a professor found a 2000 year old scroll, the article said. And those around him said that he definitely should reveal it to the world. The scroll they said proved to be that age, but I cannot confirm the age of the writing on it.

CONTINUING PROPHECY IN THE NEWS— The person said someone copied what Jesus had spoken or what He Himself had written! Here is some of the events spoken. — “It was claimed that Jesus would return before the century ended. — It unveiled the horrifying storms, quakes and perilous times upon the earth just before this! It said Jesus Himself would give battle against Satan in Armageddon in not too many years from now!” — They went on to talk about the rising of the anti-Christ from a western section soon. (A false messiah) — Of course, others have already said that it sounded just like the Scripts in many ways! We will let the reader discern for themself. — Note; Some of the things I believe they inserted or put in there was a little bit different than they should be concerning the Bible and the Scripts. Mankind could have inserted their viewpoints if indeed someone wrote what Jesus said 2000 years ago. — I believe what He spoke was put in just the Scriptures, but we decided to show that our Scripts have said prophecy will come from all directions now, from the true and the false! “So we will leave this in the Lord’s hands because we know that His return is soon!” By the way the paper called it the Jerusalem Scroll!

THE PROPHETIC PENDULUM SWINGS— (Now back to celestial and events) Jesus said, when we would see the signs and wonders in the heavens (Luke 21:25) the seas and waves would be roaring! There would be distress and perplexity among the nations! This means the weather patterns would be disrupted, and the winters and summers would be extreme! We are witnessing this now! Plus the Scripts said 25 years ago that the weather and nature would not be in its proper order and etc. Behold, saith the Lord before I make all things new most parts of the world will be shaken, burned, turned upside down, and the mountains and cities will be spread out like the sands and the rocks! Yea, for a mighty upheaval and unexpected changes shall be in the forefront continuing out the century! Behold, be ye also ready for the hour approaches for all to be fulfilled in this generation!} — Witness saith the Lord while ye have the light with you for soon darkness shall replace the true light thereof!

CONTINUING IMPORTANT PROPHECY— Sunspot cycles — “The scientists are now repeating what the Scripts said decades ago concerning apocalyptic weather and travailing nature!” These sun cycle signs will reach a maximum and minimum peak towards the end of the century. So we will definitely witness some of the most devastating acts of nature than we have ever seen before! — “Also, I predicted the greatest volcanic eruptions of the age. The greatest winds and storms of the century, plus huge asteroids will fall.” Some will explode close to the earth similar to what happened in Siberia in 1908. — One would not recognize this as the same planet by the year 2001. — Note: “Scientists now are watching certain Comets, large fragments and asteroids in certain places in the heavens!” For they know that in the near future some will strike this planet. Amen! Jesus said within this closing generation star fragments would fall. (Matt. Chap. 24) — Also, may I warn more famine and droughts will begin to increase towards the end of the century. Until by the year 2000 or so one could hardly believe the death and devastation that will occur! — “I might add concerning other events of all types in the next few years definitely expect the unexpected to transpire!”

DO NOT SLEEP— KEEP AWAKE — “All of these vital prophecies are to alert the elect and to keep them praying and witnessing!” — I foresee this century will be remembered by the great continental and vast land change. Truly a different world will appear then we now see! — Here are a few prophecies. This will take place, but when? — My opinion is before the 21st Century. “ The Vatican will disappear in fire and ashes, vaporized. It’s also my opinion that not too far after this the new temple in Jerusalem will be destroyed which is spoken about in Rev. 11:1-2 — Also the whole world will be controlled by computers, electronics and new inventions! The population will be in complete bondage! Which at first they think is peace and freedom, but it turns into a nightmare led by a Satanic prince from the bottomless pit.”

THE ENDING HOURS— A powerful restoration and great outpouring of spiritual rain is coming among His people now! It is the rainbow cycle. “This is the hour of salvation and deliverance!” — Beautiful lights will be seen in the heavens. — “God’s Holy Watchers and cherubims are preparing the way for the Translation!” — Also be careful Satanic lights will be preparing to enter the earth more often and make contact with the world. — “God is warning this planet is heading for a space wobble. The earth axis is preparing to shift and tilt back and forth!” (More on this later, plus some International subjects of different types.) — God love you, we are living in the most wonderful days! Take advantage of this harvest! — “Jesus is with you!”
